messages.subject: Workshop on R/qtl and R/qtl2 2017-06-13
messages.body_plain:
I'm teaching a one-day workshop on R/qtl <http://rqtl.org> and R/qtl2 <http://kbroman.org/qtl2> on 2017-06-13 in Memphis, in conjunction with the Complex Trait Community (CTC) meeting, http://www.complextrait.org/ctc2017/

The cost is $50. Registration is due 2 May. Sorry for the short notice.

karl
